verdict.rationale: The docs pack is dominated by single-feature reference pages (function calling, structured output, embeddings, live API, batch API) rather than end-to-end worked tutorials; the quickstart page (gemini-docs-19) claims to walk through multiple capabilities together and 'Gemini API Skills' (gemini-gh-1/2) inject best-practice patterns for coding agents, offering a thin signal of broader workflow guidance. Missing for 10: an actual cookbook repository or named multi-step tutorial (e.g., building a RAG app or agent end-to-end), independent/hands-on confirmation that these examples go beyond single-call snippets.
